html:
The Ayabacas were an Andean people of the highlands of Piura in far northern Peru, around the town of Ayabaca near the border with Ecuador.

Little is known of them before the Incas. The Inca Empire conquered the region in the late 1400s, probably under Topa Inca Yupanqui, and built the large administrative centre of Aypate on a mountain above Ayabaca, on the Inca road to Quito. Neighbouring peoples included the Calvas and Paltas.
sum: The Ayabacas were an Andean people of the highlands of Piura in far northern Peru, around the town of Ayabaca near the border with Ecuador.
